$comment: Merch print files only (no mockups). Item list, trim sizes, bleed and safe areas are common vendor print areas (the spyglass-ds and context-ds engines use the same conventions; confirm with the vendor template). Layouts are in inches from the trim. Only the approved lockups (logo.json: the octopus and wordmark, the wordmark alone, the octopus alone) and the brand's own patterns (the wordmark tile, the outline band, hatching, the reef) are used. The octopus is full-color art, so it prints only on full-color variants; one-color variants (embroidery, one-ink screen print) carry the wordmark alone. Colors come from the variant, as tokens. Only the words that are passed are printed (sample copy with --sample). Highlighted words are pink on purple and ink, and rose (the pink's dark partner, 5.9:1 on white) elsewhere. A band or a tile prints whole wordmarks only, inside the safe area; the reef, the hatching and a printed ground run into the bleed.

items.name: Cap front panel
items.source: Common front embroidery area on a structured six-panel cap: 4 by 1.75 in. Embroidery is thread, so one color per file and no bleed; the wordmark alone. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: T-shirt front
items.source: Common adult tee front print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). Garments are not trimmed, so no bleed. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: T-shirt back
items.source: Common adult tee back print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). No bleed. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: Hoodie front
items.source: Pullover hoodie front, above the pouch pocket: 12 by 10 in is a common area (vendors range from 11.5 by 11.5 to 12 by 12 in). No bleed. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: Tote bag
items.source: Print area on a standard 15 by 16 in canvas tote: 12 by 14 in is common. No bleed. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: Mug wrap, 11 oz
items.source: 11 oz mug wrap: 9 by 3.5 in is a common print area (vendors range from 8.5 to 9.5 in wide), with 0.125 in bleed for the full wrap. The lockup sits on each side of the handle, the reef along the foot. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: Sticker, die-cut
items.source: Die-cut sticker 3 by 3 in, cut along the rounded square (CutContour path in the SVG, a spot line the cutter reads; it is not printed), 0.125 in bleed past the cut and 0.125 in safe inside it. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.

items.name: Poster, 18 by 24 in
items.source: Standard 18 by 24 in poster with 0.125 in bleed on every side and a 0.5 in safe margin. Confirm against the vendor's template before ordering.
